challenge.method: In a separate check, remove the final line feed from an in-memory copy of the plain text and compare it with licenseText. Substitute standardLicenseTemplate as the comparison field. Check the observed tag name, target type and target SHA against all three exact URLs, then vary each tag condition independently.
challenge.results: Removing the final line feed defeated equality. Substituting the template field also defeated equality. The observed release binding passed. Renaming the tag to v3.29.1, changing the target type to tree, or substituting the annotation SHA for the target SHA each defeated the release binding.

limitations: The review used the supplied SCES-1.0 revision ab26f278422772f2d9e5d4dd016407d14372a710 and policy bundle identifier 14da3f31f697ab828d4a4560f060dbe511861020db54bea7bc531e20ea0855ce. The policy bundle bytes were outside the four-source acquisition.
The JavaScript performed the equality comparison and reproduced the acquisition-reported digests. It did not independently compute SHA-256.

The annotation is unsigned. Release attribution rests on the pinned object from the SPDX repository API. The comparison covers the named files and decoded field at this commit, without normalization. License applicability, other releases, matching behavior and redistribution rights are outside its scope.
